## Install

=== "Claude Code"

    ```text
    /plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    /plugin install actions@bitwise
    ```

=== "Codex CLI"

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    codex plugin add actions@bitwise
    ```

=== "OpenCode / Antigravity"

    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/bitwise-media-group/skills
    ./skills/install.sh --global   # links every skill, this plugin's included
    ```

See [Install](../../install.md) for scopes and options.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`actions-reusable-workflows`](actions-reusable-workflows/index.md) | Wire a repository to the bitwise-media-group/github-workflows reusable workflows. |
| [`actions-security`](actions-security/index.md) | Security hardening for GitHub Actions workflows with a least-privilege posture. |
| [`actions-style`](actions-style/index.md) | GitHub Actions workflow authoring conventions for readable, least-privilege workflows. |
| [`actions-validate`](actions-validate/index.md) | Validate GitHub Actions workflow files locally with the actionlint then zizmor loop. |
